redman.translation: n. (Redman)人名；(英、意、芬、瑞典)雷德曼

redmayne.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 雷德梅因住所名称，可能来源于中世纪英语，含义是“红”(red)+北方英格兰方言，含义是“石塚”(cairn)

redmond.translation: n. 雷德蒙（姓氏）；雷德蒙德（美国华盛顿州城市, 微软总部）

redmouth.definition:
n. Any one of several species of marine food fishes of the
   genus Diabasis, or Haemulon, of the Southern United States, having the
   inside of the mouth bright red. Called also flannelmouth, and grunt.
redmouth.translation: 大口水牛鱼, 红口石鲈
